To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) Naïve Bayes and BayesNet are the best classifier algorithms for network attacks, b) NaïveBayes is the most accurate classifier algorithm for network attacks, c) Naïve bayes, BayesNet and Decision table are the best classifier algorithm for DoS attack, d) Naïve Bayesian is the most accurate algorithm for DoS attacks and e) J48 and BayesNet algorithms are the most accurate classifier algorithms for U2R attacks.
(i) the proposed classifier algorithms are suitable for the network attack detection; (ii) the proposed classifier selection models are effective for network intrusion detection.
a set of classifier algorithm selection models is proposed for network intrusion detection using data mining.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to select the appropriate classifier algorithm based on the characteristics of network attacks to improve the accuracy of network intrusion detection.
the selection of the best classifier algorithm for each network attack class.
the development of a model to select appropriate classifier algorithms for network intrusion detection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the performance of the classifier algorithms are different for different types of attacks.
the classifier algorithm selection models can be used to categorize the different network attacks.
the proposed model is a good choice to select a classifier algorithm for a given network attack.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed two classifier selection models to categorize network attacks based on the evaluation of the performance of a set of classifier algorithm on the KDD99 dataset.
, the classifier selection model based on decision tree algorithm is better than that based on BayesNet algorithm.
, we have developed two classifier algorithm selection model to classify the network attacks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of multiple classifiers is better than a single classifier for detecting various network attacks.
, it is not necessary to use one algorithm for all the network attacks, but to select the best algorithm to classify each attack class.
a single classifier algorithm cannot achieve the optimal performance for all types of attacks and a combination of multiple classifiers is required to achieve optimal performance.
